title: LedgerEntry (immutable signed movement)
description: The repo's canonical money fact: one immutable, signed movement of one asset against one account. INVARIANTS (apps/api/internal/finance/ledger/ledger.go NewEntry enforces all of them and refuses, never repairs): Amount is a signed canonical decimal string and is NEVER EXACTLY ZERO - 'a movement that moves nothing is not a record'; Kind is from the closed set; a reference-bound Kind (trade_settlement, fee, funding) requires ReferenceType AND ReferenceID; positive Amount credits AccountID and negative debits it. There is NO UPDATE PATH: the ledger 'never edits an existing Entry and never rewrites history - corrections are new entries of KindAdjustment'. IDENTITY IS A NATURAL KEY, not the row id: (AccountID, Kind, ReferenceType, ReferenceID, OccurredAtMs) encoded into an idempotency key, with Amount and CreatedAt deliberately EXCLUDED so that a re-delivered event with a corrected amount still maps to the same fact rather than forking a second row.

asset.description: Symbol string today (the Go field). asset_id joins it once asset ids exist.

amount.description: SIGNED and NEVER EXACTLY ZERO. Positive credits account_id, negative debits it. The Go constructor refuses a zero amount in any spelling ('0', '0.00', '-0') because a movement that moves nothing is not a record.

reference_type.description: Names the record that caused the movement; REQUIRED for the reference-bound kinds, absent otherwise.

occurred_at.description: The world time of the movement (the Go field OccurredAtMs). Part of the idempotency key.

recorded_at.description: The Go field CreatedAt. Deliberately NOT part of the idempotency key.

kind.description: Closed set (finance/ledger Kind). 'adjustment' is the ONLY way history is amended - by appending, never by editing. Reference-bound kinds: trade_settlement, fee, funding.
